verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
verses.pt: E aconteceu, depois dessas coisas, que Deus provou Abraão, e disse-lhe: Abraão. E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.
verses.en_web: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
verses.en_bbe: Now after these things, God put Abraham to the test, and said to him, Abraham; and he said, Here am I.

verses.en: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
verses.pt: E disse: Toma agora teu filho, teu único, Isaque, a quem amas, e vai à terra de Moriá, e oferece-o ali em holocausto sobre um dos montes que eu te direi.
verses.en_web: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, whom you love, even Isaac, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, Take your son, your dearly loved only son Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah and give him as a burned offering on one of the mountains of which I will give you knowledge.

verses.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
verses.pt: E Abraão se levantou manhã muito cedo, e preparou seu asno, e tomou consigo dois servos seus, e a Isaque seu filho: e cortou lenha para o holocausto, e levantou-se, e foi ao lugar que Deus lhe disse.
verses.en_web: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham got up early in the morning, and made ready his ass, and took with him two of his young men and Isaac, his son, and after the wood for the burned offering had been cut, he went on his way to the place of which God had given him word.

verses.en: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
verses.pt: Ao terceiro dia levantou Abraão seus olhos, e viu o lugar de longe.
verses.en_web: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.
verses.en_bbe: And on the third day, Abraham, lifting up his eyes, saw the place a long way off.

verses.en: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you,
verses.pt: Então disse Abraão a seus servos: Esperai aqui com o asno, e eu e o jovem iremos até ali, e adoraremos, e voltaremos a vós.
verses.en_web: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go yonder. We will worship, and come back to you.”
verses.en_bbe: Then he said to his young men, Keep here with the ass; and I and the boy will go on and give worship and come back again to you.

verses.en: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
verses.pt: E tomou Abraão a lenha do holocausto, e a pôs sobre Isaque seu filho: e ele tomou em sua mão o fogo e a espada; e foram ambos juntos.
verses.en_web: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham put the wood for the burned offering on his son's back, and he himself took the fire and the knife in his hand, and the two of them went on together.

verses.en: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
verses.pt: Então falou Isaque a Abraão seu pai, e disse: Meu pai. e ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui, meu filho. E ele disse: Eis aqui o fogo e a lenha; mas onde está o cordeiro para o holocausto?
verses.en_web: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”
verses.en_bbe: Then Isaac said to Abraham, My father; and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, We have wood and fire here, but where is the lamb for the burned offering?

verses.en: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
verses.pt: E respondeu Abraão: Deus se proverá de cordeiro para o holocausto, filho meu. E iam juntos.
verses.en_web: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham said, God himself will give the lamb for the burned offering: so they went on together.

verses.en: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
verses.pt: E quando chegaram ao lugar que Deus lhe havia dito, edificou ali Abraão um altar, e compôs a lenha, e amarrou a Isaque seu filho, e pôs-lhe no altar sobre a lenha.
verses.en_web: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.
verses.en_bbe: And they came to the place of which God had given him knowledge; and there Abraham made the altar and put the wood in place on it, and having made tight the bands round Isaac his son, he put him on the wood on the altar.

verses.en: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
verses.pt: E estendeu Abraão sua mão, e tomou a espada, para degolar a seu filho.
verses.en_web: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.
verses.en_bbe: And stretching out his hand, Abraham took the knife to put his son to death.

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
verses.pt: Então o anjo do SENHOR lhe gritou do céu, e disse: Abraão, Abraão. E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
verses.en_bbe: But the voice of the angel of the Lord came from heaven, saying, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.

verses.en: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
verses.pt: E disse: Não estendas tua mão sobre o jovem, nem lhe faças nada; que já conheço que temes a Deus, pois que não me recusaste o teu filho, o teu único;
verses.en_web: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Let not your hand be stretched out against the boy to do anything to him; for now I am certain that the fear of God is in your heart, because you have not kept back your son, your only son, from me.

verses.en: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
verses.pt: Então levantou Abraão seus olhos, e olhou, e eis um carneiro a suas costas preso em um arbusto por seus chifres: e foi Abraão, e tomou o carneiro, e ofereceu-lhe em holocausto em lugar de seu filho.
verses.en_web: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.
verses.en_bbe: And lifting up his eyes, Abraham saw a sheep fixed by its horns in the brushwood: and Abraham took the sheep and made a burned offering of it in place of his son.

verses.en: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.
verses.pt: E chamou Abraão o nome daquele lugar, O SENHOR proverá. Portanto se diz hoje: No monte do SENHOR se proverá.
verses.en_web: Abraham called the name of that place Yahweh Will Provide. As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will be provided.”
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham gave that place the name Yahweh-yireh: as it is said to this day, In the mountain the Lord is seen.

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
verses.pt: E chamou o anjo do SENHOR a Abraão segunda vez desde o céu,
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,
verses.en_bbe: And the voice of the angel of the Lord came to Abraham a second time from heaven,

verses.en: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
verses.pt: E disse: Por mim mesmo jurei, diz o SENHOR, que porquanto fizeste isto, e não me recusaste teu filho, teu único;
verses.en_web: and said, “I have sworn by myself, says Yahweh, because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,
verses.en_bbe: Saying, I have taken an oath by my name, says the Lord, because you have done this and have not kept back from me your dearly loved only son,

verses.en: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
verses.pt: certamente te abençoarei, e multiplicarei tua descendência como as estrelas do céu, e como a areia que está na beira do mar; e tua descendência possuirá as portas de seus inimigos:
verses.en_web: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.
verses.en_bbe: That I will certainly give you my blessing, and your seed will be increased like the stars of heaven and the sand by the seaside; your seed will take the land of those who are against them;

verses.en: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
verses.pt: Em tua descendência serão abençoadas todas as nações da terra, porquanto obedeceste à minha voz.
verses.en_web: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.”
verses.en_bbe: And your seed will be a blessing to all the nations of the earth, because you have done what I gave you orders to do.

verses.en: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.
verses.pt: E voltou Abraão a seus servos, e levantaram-se e se foram juntos a Berseba; e habitou Abraão em Berseba.
verses.en_web: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.
verses.en_bbe: Then Abraham went back to his young men and they went together to Beer-sheba, the place where Abraham was living.

verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
verses.pt: E aconteceu depois destas coisas, que foi dada notícia a Abraão, dizendo: Eis que também Milca havia dado à luz filhos a teu irmão Naor:
verses.en_web: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:
verses.en_bbe: After these things, Abraham had news that Milcah, the wife of his brother Nahor, had given birth to children;

verses.en: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
verses.pt: A Uz, seu primogênito, e a Buz, seu irmão, e a Quemuel, pai de Arã.
verses.en_web: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,
verses.en_bbe: Uz the oldest, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel, the father of Aram,

verses.en: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
verses.pt: E a Quésede, e a Hazo, e a Pildas, e a Jidlafe, e a Betuel.
verses.en_web: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
verses.en_bbe: And Chesed and Hazo and Pildash and Jidlaph and Bethuel.

verses.en: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
verses.pt: E Betuel gerou Rebeca. Milca deu à luz estes oito de Naor, irmão de Abraão.
verses.en_web: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
verses.en_bbe: Bethuel was the father of Rebekah: these eight were the children of Milcah and Nahor, Abraham's brother.

verses.en: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
verses.pt: E sua concubina, que se chamava Reumá, deu à luz também a Tebá, e a Gaã, e a Taás, e a Maaca.
verses.en_web: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
verses.en_bbe: And his servant Reumah gave birth to Tebah and Gaham and Tahash and Maacah.
